<title level="1" pfs="">[Hexmoth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3290)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

A hexworm, upon consuming a sufficient quantity of magic, will spin a cocoon of magically infused silk, metamorphosing into its imago form.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 24

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 22

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 19
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Hexmoth.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 8">[Hexmoth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3290)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 159

**Perception** +19; arcanosense ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +16, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) +18, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +14

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +3

**Dex** +6

**Con** +3

**Int** -4

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Arcanosense** A hexmoth can sense sources of magic at the listed range as though it has a 4th-rank [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485) constant innate spell.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 27 

**Fort** +19 

**Ref** +16 

**Will** +11 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 105

</row>

**Immunities**
advanced arcanovore

**Advanced Arcanovore** A hexmoth has resistance 10 against all damage caused by spells. It's immune to one type of energy it consumed most as a hexworm, typically acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, fly 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
proboscis +13,
**Damage** 2d10+9 piercing plus Arcane Consumption

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
hexbolt +13 ([range 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 2d8+6 of the energy damage the hexmoth is immune to

**Arcane Consumption** <actions string="Single Action" />  The hexmoth attempts to consume the magic of an adjacent magical effect or unattended magic item. It attempts a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against the target with a +17 modifier. On a success, the magical effect ends. A magic item instead becomes a mundane item for 1 round. The hexmoth gains 2d8 Hit Points.

**Arcanotaxis** <actions string="Free Action" />  **Requirements** The hexmoth has detected a source of magic with its arcanosense; **Trigger** The hexmoth's turn begins; **Effect** The hexmoth Strides or [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) up to its Speed toward the nearest source of magic it can detect.

**Hexdust Wind** <actions string="Two Actions" />  With a few fierce wingbeats, the hexmoth expels magical scale dust in a 30-foot cone. This deals 10d6 damage of the type to which the hexmoth is immune (DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). It can't use Hexdust Wind again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-498" />
name: Hexmoth
